## Parula (G4)

Parula is a *Friendship Is Magic* background pegasus mare: a pale cream-yellow pony with a long, dark slate-blue mane and tail in a Fluttershy-like style. She is recognizable among the spectators at the ceremony honoring the Mane Six after Discord's defeat in *The Return of Harmony – Part 2* (season 2, episode 2). The [pegasus character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies) locates her at approximately 21:42 of the episode.

*Name and status:* “Parula” is an **unofficial fandom/wiki placeholder**, not a verified name spoken in the show or confirmed through merchandise or production credits. Her actual eye color and cutie mark are not shown. She has no verified dialogue, credited voice actor, alter ego, or further television appearances.
